movies.title: You Can See Everything
movies.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait becomes a mind-bending three-year journey.

movies.title: Street Fighter
movies.overview: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

movies.title: Whalefall
movies.overview: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

movies.title: Love of Your Life
movies.overview: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

movies.title: Animals
movies.overview: Desperate to pay their son's ransom, a mayoral candidate and his wife resort to extreme measures, revealing dark secrets they never intended to bring to light.

shows.title: Crystal Lake
shows.overview: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

shows.title: Below
shows.overview: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

shows.title: Carrie
shows.overview: After her father's sudden death, sheltered teenager Carrie White, raised by her domineering mother, enters public high school, where she faces a viral bullying scandal and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers.

shows.title: East of Eden
shows.overview: In the farmlands of the Salinas Valley in California, successive generations of two families, the Trasks and the Hamiltons, are destined to reenact the fateful story of Cain and Abel.

shows.title: A Different World
shows.overview: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at Hillman College, her parents' HBCU alma mater, where she must escape their shadow and build her own legacy.

anime.title: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
anime.overview: The Seido baseball club has been invited to the spring invitational at the hallowed Koshien Stadium. Sawamura will finally stand on the mound! Standing between Seido and the nation…

anime.title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2
anime.overview: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen .

anime.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
anime.overview: Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.

anime.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
anime.overview: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.
